answer: Agents can earn a harbor’s scarce signing slots by posting a bond that is forfeited when independent auditors prove the same operator controls multiple identities. Auditors check randomly assigned, private tasks against costly records of prior work, so copying a public answer is not enough. This does not make Sybils impossible: an attacker can fund them, but must lock up capital for every identity and risks losing it. An ivory badge or a fable about uniqueness earns no trust without that stake.
